Title: Abolish Lock Poisoning
Optimizing Rustc's next trait solver
Description:
The next rust trait solver, a large subsystem of the rust compiler that we've been trying to replace, will finally land in rust 1.102.0. In the last stages, before stabilizing it, its performance was a major blocker. But what is "a trait solver"? And why is its performance a problem? My goal for this blog post is to answer those questions in a way where you don't need any prior knowledge. I think discussions of the trait solver can quickly become quite involved, and daunting. So today, we'll start from the very basics!

Title: Ansible Fails waiting for privilege escalation on Ubuntu 26
Description:
I've slowly been moving my servers from Ubuntu 22 and 24 to 26 this year, and noticed my Ansible automation starts failing if I have password protection for sudo use:
$ ansible-playbook main.yml -K BECOME password: PLAY [Security] ******************************************************* TASK [Gathering Facts] *********************************************************************** fatal: [my-server.local]: FAILED! => msg: 'Timeout (12s) waiting for privilege escalation prompt: ' Apparently Ubuntu's been rewriting system utilities in Rust, and the sudo-rs version that ships on Ubuntu 26.04 has some incompatiblities with the sudo I've used on servers for 20+ years.
